results.summary: This Wokwi project implements the 'secret code' exercise from the TinyTapeout workshop. If the correct code 10101010 is set on IN0 through IN7, the design outputs 10001100 on OUT0 through OUT7 to display the letter 'r' on a 7-segment display. Any other input outputs 00000000. External hardware includes a DIP switch for inputs and a 7-segment display for outputs.
